# ClickUp — ClickUp for Startups

$3,000 in ClickUp credit plus an upgraded Enterprise workspace and onboarding resources, for startups affiliated with an approved ClickUp funding partner.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open, but needs an accelerator, VC or partner code |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |

## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | credit |
| **Maximum** | $3,000 — see the vendor's exact wording below |


### Not covered

- Startups that have raised beyond a Series B round
- Companies incorporated 5 or more years ago
- Existing paying ClickUp customers (eligibility requires being 'New to ClickUp or currently on the Free Forever Plan')
